$comment: Orphaned i18n keys — defined in src/i18n/locales/en (and mostly mirrored in zh) but
referenced nowhere in src. Read by scripts/i18n-verify-keys.mjs (verifyOrphans).
THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. A new orphan fails the gate. An entry here that stops being
an orphan ALSO fails the gate, so the file cannot rot into a standing excuse.
Every entry is copy that outlived the thing that rendered it: a feature was retired or a
component deleted, and the locale JSON stayed behind in both locales, where it still costs
translation and review. That is the leak the locale -> code direction was added to stop
(2026-08-17). Before it, nothing in this repo walked that way, so the only way to find these
was to grep by hand — which is how the keys cleaned up around 968e8043 were found.
Each reason below was checked against `git log -S` on src/. Where the provenance could NOT
be traced, the entry says so rather than guessing.
These are baselined rather than deleted because removing live-looking product copy is a
call for a human, not a drive-by in an i18n-gate change. Deleting any of them from en/ and
zh/ and dropping the line here is a correct one-line contribution.
2026-08-17: that human call was made. The list opened at 50; Ethan reviewed the grouping in
docs/i18n-orphan-decisions.md and approved 35 deletions, which were executed in both locales
in one pass. The 15 that remain are KEEPS, not backlog — the feature behind each one still
has its data layer, its wiring, or its field live, so the copy is paused rather than dead.
Re-read that document before deleting any of them; the reason strings below are the summary,
not the argument. One of the 15 (marketplace:service.notesLabel) is re-traced there and is
awaiting a second decision.
